# Orange

Orange is a dark theme with an orange accent: bolded sidebar folder titles, distinct orange file names, orange hover highlights and dark backgrounds. Header colors and sizes, table and code-block styles and other UI accents are adjusted through CSS variables.

![Orange screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afrangi/Obsidian-Theme-Orange/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Orange"
    author: "afrangi"
    repo:   "afrangi/Obsidian-Theme-Orange"
    slug:   "orange"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/orange"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/afrangi/Obsidian-Theme-Orange"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afrangi/Obsidian-Theme-Orange/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a subtle orange dark theme with bolded sidebar folder titles, distinct orange file names, orange hover highlights, and dark backgrounds for distraction-free reading. Customize header colors and sizes, table and code-block styles, and UI accents via simple CSS variables."
}
```
